We spent about four minutes coming up with the original name of Alternative Investment

and in the hedge fund space.
And there's an old saying is surround yourself with people who are smarter than you and

My wife likes to say that's not very difficult for me.

But we've ended up creating commingled entities on both those asset classes with the idea

We joke that we're like a dating service.
We always say that match.com has nothing on us because we're constantly putting our managers

who hopefully can help them do a better job investing.
And if they make an extra dollar, we all win.

So let's circle back to, you know, you mentioned we and the family and matchmaking.

point. He did a fantastic job personally making the transition from investment banker

of Bear Stearns. But I remember one morning standing there at about probably three or four in the

the campaign manager traveled. We did five states in a day. You start believing

every single rock. I remember many trips with you and others that we have mutual respect for

want to share it with our partners because not only does that help, but it also helps with our partners

give a little capacity here, a little capacity there. And so people are also fine. And so people are

work doing your unique own homework matters. I think it's always good to know what

capturing and capturing information. It's also then taking a quick look in saying,

Could you introduce me?

We use my LinkedIn account as a firm.

character. And at the end of the day,
It's all about character. And it's how is somebody going to treat us? So if there's an issue
